```lean
theorem lg_target {α : Type*} (A B : Set α) : A ⊆ B ↔ A ∩ B = A := by
  split
  · intro h
    apply Set.eq_of_subset_of_subset
    · intro x hx
      apply Set.mem_inter_iff.1 hx
      exact h
    · intro x hx
      apply Set.mem_inter_iff.2 hx
      exact Set.mem_set_of_eq.2 (Or.inl rfl)
  · intro h'
    apply Set.eq_of_subset_of_subset
    · intro x hx
      apply Set.mem_inter_iff.1 hx
      exact Set.mem_set_of_eq.2 (Or.inr rfl)
    · intro x hx
      apply Set.mem_inter_iff.2 hx
      exact h'
```
